High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Commander Desanne (Errata)]] (the card with its Decipher errata text and the errata mark) (Cloud City, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Commander Desanne _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/11tSb44gisbDY7SDeWQPklGwSV12j6HTF/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Commander Desanne _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,728 bytes, SHA-256 <code>ac6e42ffaeacca76e1e3a5954a190e077ca111ae6d49ff3f3df2d3e2966fe17e</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

This credited gold-E print-ready fan recreation remains a qualified comparison. It is not an automatic same-image high-resolution scan of the official D-E1 full source at [[Commander Desanne (PC Errata 4)]] or the actual documentary excerpt at [[Commander Desanne (Errata)]]. Original TIFF, master, credit and license provenance remain unchanged.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
